## Before asking for review

- [ ] `python tools/check.py` passes
- [ ] `python tools/build_static.py` run, and the changed screen opened and read
- [ ] No figure estimated, interpolated or converted
- [ ] News written in plain words, with no long quotation
- [ ] `known_gaps` in `data/meta.json` still true
